topic: Down to the final question of a physics quiz bowl, he blurted out the SI unit of electric current.
core_question: What is the SI unit of electric current? (secondary: Which country has the largest land area in the world?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is the ampere.; after the topic shift: Russia is the largest country in the world by land area.
persona: skeptical and testy; texting quickly with typos here and there
